towns.name: Yanshi
towns.summary: Yanshi, 'Town of the Boulder', is the Sho town on the plains NW of the Blackmire Swamp, settled by Sho who left Hebian-To for a great lone rock in a field; the legendary Ben Ten defended it against the Tumeroks. In 13 PY Gaerlan's failed attempt to summon the Harbinger destroyed the old town above his chamber (Old Yanshi ruins and the Sacred Stone lie 1 km east); in 16 PY Yanshi was rebuilt as a walled town on a hill to the west near the Leafcull festival grounds, with a memorial to Antius Blackmoor; in 21 PY Prince Borelean Strathelar and Hoshino Kei were wed in the meadow outside its walls. In the DAT: a square walled town (107 x 131 m, 7 m brick walls, 19.6 m corner and gate towers) on a z 42 hill; a 34 m-wide south gate between two towers faces the road and the Antius Blackmoor Memorial (a 3x-scale human statue on a 6.8 m pedestal). Inside: a 31 m octagonal pagoda on a raised platform with two lanterns at its door, Sho houses, the Shrine to Xao Wu, the Life Stone and the Town Network portal. Below the SE corner a font among four blossoming trees with a lantern; west in the meadow the wedding site - an aisle carpet between stone benches and topiary to a red-and-white wedding arch flanked by two sparkling crystal fountains, tulip beds and blue and red tents.
